analyze_options.description:
Analyze a multi-leg options position.

Computes Greeks per leg and total, payoff scenarios at 100 price levels,
break-even points, probabilities (ITM/OTM, profit), and strategy classification
using the Options Playbook framework.

Supports multi-expiry positions (calendar spreads, diagonal spreads): each
leg dict may carry an optional ``expiry`` key (YYYY-MM-DD). Per-leg expiry
takes precedence over the global ``expiry`` parameter.

expiry.description:
Global target expiry (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for legs without
    per-leg expiry. REQUIRED — the tool rejects calls without it.

legs.description:
List of leg dicts with type, strike, qty, entry_premium.
  Each leg can optionally include "expiry" (YYYY-MM-DD) for
  multi-expiry positions (calendar spreads, diagonals).

analyze_stock.description:
Deep single-stock analysis through all dimensions.

Returns a comprehensive analysis including ``action_recommendation``
with an operational recommendation (BUY/HOLD/AVOID) based on
evidence-based volume profile signals (180d horizon, OOS-validated).

fetch_news.description: If True, scrape yfinance/Finviz news for web sentiment.

include_options_context.description: If True, fetch options chain data too.

verbose.description:
If True, include full detail strings and sub-scores.
     Default False.

output_schema.description:
Output of ``analyze_stock``.

``verdict`` is a free-form operational label; ``composite_score`` and the
volume-profile semantics behind it live in the analysis code, not here.
The ``status="insufficient_data"`` variant reports ``history_bars`` and
``required_bars`` instead of scores.

bakshi_signals.description:
Bakshi & Kapadia (2003) volatility risk premium analysis.

Delta-hedged gains and the negative market volatility risk premium.
Analizza il VRP corrente, expected P&L per vari strikes, e fornisce
suggerimenti operativi per VRP harvesting.

USA IL DATAPROVIDER per dati OHLCV e expirations.

expiry.description: Data scadenza opzioni (YYYY-MM-DD). Auto-seleziona se None.

period.description: Periodo per il calcolo della RV (default: '1y').

output_schema.description:
Output of ``bali_signals`` (Bali & Hovakimian 2009 volatility spreads).

``available=False`` marks a failure path: ``composite_bali_score`` is then
``None`` and ``error_is_blocking`` says whether the signal can be used.

breakout_context.description:
Momentum bias-guard + conditional breakout trigger for a ticker.

Returns a structured payload with: momentum/extension metrics, an
explicit ``bias_guard`` that fires when a trending/momentum name would
otherwise be mis-read with mean-reversion logic, a *conditional and NOT
statistically certified* breakout trigger, a best-effort regime-aware
GEX overlay, ATR-based risk levels, and the honesty disclaimer.

The breakout trigger fires when the latest close is above the 252d high
with volume > 2x the 20d average AND price above SMA200. Phase 1
calibration proved that NO raw breakout configuration beat the baseline
in-sample, so ``evidence.edge_certified`` is always False.

include_gex.description: If True, include the best-effort GEX overlay.

output_schema.description: Output of ``breakout_context`` (bias guard, trigger, GEX overlay, risk).

clear_macro_cache.description: Force clear the macro context cache. Next call will re-fetch fresh data.

fetch_crypto_data.description: Fetch crypto data from CoinGecko and yfinance.

fetch_options_chain.description: Fetch options chain with Greeks and IV metrics.

expiry.description:
Target expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). REQUIRED — the tool rejects calls
    without it. If the exact date is unavailable, snaps to the nearest
    available expiry.

strike_window.description:
Number of strikes to keep around ATM on each side
    (default 10 → ±10 strikes, ~70-90% smaller payload). Pass None
    or -1 to return the full chain.

output_schema.description:
Output of ``fetch_options_chain``.

``_source`` is ``live``, ``cache`` or ``fallback``; ``data_quality``
tells whether Greeks are native or Black-Scholes computed locally.

iv_metrics.description:
Implied-volatility aggregates for one chain.

``iv_rank`` / ``iv_percentile`` are ``None`` when no historical IV series
exists; ``iv_range_position`` is the within-chain position, not a rank.

fetch_stock_data.description: Fetch complete stock data: OHLCV history, fundamentals, and indicators.

get_macro_context.description:
Get current macro context: VIX, DXY, Fed rate, Fear & Greed, BTC dominance.

Fetches real-time macro indicators from yfinance and detects the
current market regime (CRISIS, HIGH_VOLATILITY, RANGE_BOUND,
TRENDING_BULL, TRENDING_BEAR) with dynamic weight recommendations.

Results are cached for 60 seconds to prevent yfinance rate limiting.
Use clear_macro_cache() to force a refresh.

output_schema.description:
Output of ``get_macro_context``.

``macro_window`` is derived from ``detected_regime`` so the two can never
contradict each other.

get_skill_knowledge.description:
Get knowledge from a specific trading skill (SKILL.md).

Retrieve trading framework definitions on-demand without loading
entire skill files into context. Use this when you need a specific
concept, pattern, or strategy definition.

section.description: Optional heading to return just that section (reduces tokens).

output_schema.description:
Output of ``get_skill_knowledge``.

``content`` is capped (see ``truncated``) and ``sections`` lists the
available headings so the caller can re-query one section.

gex_analysis.description:
Compute Gamma Exposure (GEX) for a ticker's option chain.

Calculates dealer gamma exposure per strike (call GEX positive,
put GEX negative; GEX = gamma * OI * 100 * S^2 * 0.01, i.e. dollars
per 1% underlying move), the total net GEX, the strike-by-strike
profile, the zero-gamma / Gamma Flip level, the Call Wall and Put
Wall, and the prevailing gamma regime (long-gamma = mean-reverting /
pinning, short-gamma = volatility-amplifying).

expiry.description:
Optional 'YYYY-MM-DD' expiry. When None, chains up to
``max_expiries`` listed expirations are aggregated.

max_dte.description:
Maximum days to expiry; 0DTE and longer-dated expirations
are excluded (default 120, matching the reference).

top_n.description: Number of strikes kept in the returned profile (default 15).

output_schema.description:
Output of ``gex_analysis``.

``net_gex`` is in dollars per 1% underlying move (per-share gamma
convention, see :mod:`trading_mcp.analysis.gex`).

lgbm_postprocess.description:
Post-processing dello score LGBM con 8 skill-adjustments.

Applica correzioni basate sulle skill di trading per affinare
la confidenza dello score LGBM grezzo. NON usa LightGBM — solo
numpy, pandas, e DataProvider per i dati.

lgbm_predict.description:
LightGBM stacking ensemble prediction.

Carica il modello LGBM pre-addestrato per il ticker e produce
uno score 0-100 (stacking ensemble con meta-model).

USA IL DATAPROVIDER per i dati OHLCV e macro (cache hit garantito
se analyze_stock e' stato chiamato prima).

Se non esiste un modello pre-addestrato, restituisce un errore
esplicativo. Per addestrare un modello:
  python scripts/run_stacking.py --ticker {ticker} --start 2020-01-01

output_schema.description:
Output of ``lgbm_predict``.

The 0-100 score is not a probability: ``calibrated_probability`` stays
None until an out-of-sample calibration artifact is validated.

scan_market.description:
Scan a market universe for accumulation patterns and rank by score.

Parallel scanning via ThreadPoolExecutor. 500 tickers in ~45s.

fetch_news.description: If True, scrape Finviz/WSB for web sentiment.

verbose.description: If True, include full detail strings and sub-scores. Default False.

items.description: One ranked ticker inside a ``scan_market`` batch.

suggest_options_strategy.description:
Suggest an options strategy based on stock analysis verdict.

Combines the verdict from analyze_stock with IV regime assessment
to recommend a specific options strategy from the Options Playbook.

verdict.description:
Verdict from analyze_stock ('Long-Term Investment',
     'Short-Term Speculation (Bullish)', 'Avoid / Wait').

tsmom_signals.description: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012) time series momentum.
